acceptance_reason: Only bounded local regions simulate dynamically; ocean interaction follows explicit reservoir/level rules; all local volume change is attributable to measured reservoir exchange; no infinite-spread activation occurs.

definition.fail_criteria: Ocean contact activates unbounded propagation, water appears/disappears without accounted reservoir exchange, or unloaded interfaces corrupt local state.
definition.inconclusive_conditions: Ocean is merely a rendered plane with no gameplay interaction or local-fluid semantics.
invalidation_conditions: Evidence is unusable due to wrong build/configuration, measurement defect or contamination.
A proof run without adequate exact build identity may be INVALIDATED.
observables: local volume change explained by reservoir flux
definition.pass_criteria: Only bounded local regions simulate dynamically; ocean interaction follows explicit reservoir/level rules; all local volume change is attributable to measured reservoir exchange; no infinite-spread activation occurs.
procedure: Connect finite local chambers to an explicit analytic ocean reservoir.
Open/reseal breaches, move the active window, and unload/reload the local region.
Account every local volume change against reservoir flux while applying backpressure.
definition.question: Can the global/static ocean concept interact with bounded local simulated fluid without activating an unbounded world-sized fluid simulation or creating/removing water at the interface?
definition.required_repetition: Hundreds of breach/reseal cycles and long coastal traversal/load-unload runs.
definition.title: Ocean / Local Fluid Boundary

observations: Ocean interaction remained an explicit reservoir flux into a finite active domain.
